[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 45
- Description: Strategy session: Sophia as a commercial product (vertical selection + referral engine)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1721
  
  Details:
  45-minute strategy discussion between Gary Teh and Peter Gwee on commercialising Sophia beyond the DAO.
  
  Topics covered:
  - Applying Sophia to banks and insurance companies as a vertical
  - Reaching out to trading companies to identify headaches Sophia could serve today; identify most frequently occurring ones and target those
  - Referral dynamics: once a viable use case is found and delivered, customers typically refer others
  
  Output captured as docs evidence in PR #1721 (SOPHIA_COMMERCIAL_STRATEGY.md), covering:
  - The wedge-then-referral loop named explicitly
  - Vertical ranking inverted on analysis: commodity/agri trading companies first (we already have dogfood in our own Brazilian export lane), banks last (SR 11-7 model risk, EU AI Act Annex III high-risk classification, DORA, NAIC AI Model Bulletin, SOC 2 / ISO 27001, 6-12 month cycles)
  - Product-shape mismatch flagged: our 2026-06-18 removal of the human approval gate is the opposite of what a bank vendor review requires — selling there needs a supervised product mode, not a repackage
  - Referral precondition: a named, referenceable, quantified case study is the gate, not merely "delivering a solution"
  - 12-question discovery interview instrument + P1-P10 pain taxonomy + occurrence log so "most frequent" is measured, not asserted
  - Second-track framing per DR_MANHATTAN: services cash can fund the mission but must not stall the China/cacao lane; run as bounded experiment with a kill criterion
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh, Peter Gwee
- TDG Issued: 75.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
